intervention_execution.claim: R95 frozen insertion and R96 common-init joint training actually executed; R102 not executed.

intended_intermediate.claim: R95 all own-score gains positive; R102 source equation exposes a possible common-component margin path, not observed mediation.

observable_output.claim: R95 Macro worsened; R96 full-minus-native development Macro/CE positive, full Macro slightly below simplex.

task_utility.claim: Discovery only, reused development and one init; new class-centering utility is not measured.

trace_adequacy.selection_rule: All original predeclared development examples in reports; no selected case attribution.
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Labels never enter the proposed forward path; fit labels only in supervised loss, evaluation labels metrics only.

primary_explanation.statement: Class-common token values can alter margins under class-dependent pooling; whether this explains actual R95 harm is unmeasured.

alternative_explanations.statement: Postfit insertion and learned decoder/routing are mismatched; joint fitting may explain R96 carryover.
Centering may help only by restricting the decoder, without measurement-update benefit.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Class-common readout removal versus measurement construction versus ordinary decoder restriction.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Matched class-centered native, class-centered full, construction-only full, uncentered full/native/simplex; compare common-mode contribution and task deltas.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Centered full has distinct benefit beyond centered-native and uncentered controls.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Centered-native matches benefit or centering harms; no update-specific support.

forbidden_rescue_variants: No optional eta/epsilon/seed/epoch rescue of the frozen postfit contract.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Jointly train the existing utility-to-measurement path with shared states/value/decoder tensors.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: One-init development evidence only; class-centering changes the function and inherits no utility tier.

selected_candidate.title: Joint class-centered construction and readout
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Remove the all-class token-utility mean before both measurement construction and readout; couple classes with a centered decoder.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Expose raw utility, token class mean, centered construction/readout utilities, alpha and logits; require centered-native control.
selected_candidate.success_gate: Synthetic algebra/gradient/source checks pass before a separately reviewed fixed joint-fit screen; discovery gate frozen in joint-fit-design.json.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Any implementation identity/finite-gradient/lineage failure stops that contract; short-screen null gives no automatic promotion or rescue.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Owner sustained bounded research; shared scheduler only; full formal runs collaborator-only; no new capacity.

limitations: New family unimplemented/unmeasured at dossier creation.
No complete case-level causal evidence or novelty clearance.
R102 analytic invariance does not imply semantic robustness or task improvement.
